Egoismus.et: Borrowed from New Latin egoismus, from Latin ego.

Egon.et: Variant of Egino, diminutive of Germanic compound names beginning with the element Egin-, from *agi (“awe”), later merged with Old High German ekka (“sharp point”) (from *aggju). Popular during the first half of the 20th century.

Egoist.et: From French égoïste, from Latin ego + -iste. By surface analysis, Ego + -ist.
